reviews.comment: Dr. Lenz is a great professor and I would 10/10 recommend! She enjoys what she teaches and genuinely wants you to learn! Answered emails quickly!

Brandi is amazing, responds to emails ASAP, truly loves her subject and loves go teach and wants to see students succeed. With the group project, she doesn't tolerate slackers and will ensure if you have someone not pulling their weight that they are punished and not the entire group.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The best prof I have ever had by far in college. She did have one semester long group project which wasn't very hard if you just locked your group in for a bit, and a final that you can use a cheat sheet on. Nicest prof ever, engaging lectures, not test heavy, I strongly recommend you take her.
Dr. Lenz is the GOAT. I took GEOL 101 with her over the summer online. She made it very easy yet also inspiring and engaging. I highly recommend her for anyone who just needs a science credit.

I took GEOL 101 online with her over summer. She is the GOAT. She made it a very easy and informative class. Not too strict, grading criteria is chill. Perfect for someone that just needs a science credit.

Dr. Lenz is great! She's easy to reach outside of class, and she communicates exams and due dates ahead of time. The class itself is also incredibly easy, but just be sure to stay on top of the weekly busy work. Exams aren't honorlocked, and she allows access to notes and class resources on exams. Wonderful professor, and the class is an easy A!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: She is very knowledgeable, but lectures are just too boring to pay attention. She is super nice all the time though so its no big deal. Easiest A of all time
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took this class for KUCD credit, and ended up being very easy A. Graded by 6 individual quizzes as well as 5 in-class discussions and activities and a final project with pre-assigned groups. Final consists of 6 FRQ questions, but you can bring a cheatsheet. Final review pretty much goes over the final. Great professor and would highly recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Completely online. Pace yourself through assignments. The discussions are simple and you are paired with the same 15 people throughout the semester.

Took this in Fall 2025. Queen Kalu was technically in charge, she was the TA for our lab. Super easy and walked us through everything an gave great examples. One project at the end of the semester and it was a presentation but super easy. 10/10 lab for geology.

Amazing professor who is very passionate about the subject. Communicates with her students about due dates throughout the week, and responds to questions very quickly. Highly recommend taking Dr. Lenz.

AMAZING professor!! She truly cares about her students, and you can tell that she actually enjoys her job. Course is extremely easy and concise. I got 99 without studying at all. Grade was comprised of 13 discussions, 6 quizzes, 4 activities, a final project, and a final exam. Lectures were online video recordings 1-2 hours each week.

Professor Lenz was an amazing prof especially for an online class. Although there were lots of things we needed to complete each week you can easily get it all done on time. She even let us complete certain items at the end of the semester for a little credit. I would suggest her for any of your geology classes; she is super passionate about it.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Easy class with work to do over the week. But regardless its a easy A if you got the work done in time.

I took this class online and it was very easy. You can tell she really enjoys geology and teaching, and was always great at communicating assignment deadlines. If you need a science elective or something definitely take geol 101 with her

This was the easiest class I have ever taken! 2 quizzes, a discussion post, and 2 responses due each week. The workload was very manageable for an online class. The professor is super sweet and wants you to succeed. Allowed to get ahead so you can basically finish everything way ahead of time. Total of three exams during the semester. TAKE HER!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took as an easy life/physical science w/the lab. It was the easiest science I've ever taken. Just stay on top of your work and you'll be fine. Tests are quizzes&participation from prev modules. Sweet professor!!

Weekly quizzes, discussions, and assignments took a while but they were very easy. I genuinely enjoyed her lectures and she's good at making a somewhat boring topic entertaining. Everything is open note and grades are fairly evenly distributed so if you bomb an exam it won't tank your grade. Do the assignments and you'll get an A easily.
Took her for online geology, just keep up with the quizzes and discussions and you'll be fine.

Class was a lot of work but it wasn't too difficult. The class was comprised of quizzes, exams, and discussions so engagement was crucial. Overall as long as you do the readings the class isn't too difficult.
Dr. Lenz is a great professor she really cares about students. I took the summer class and it was very easy. 3 exams and a few quizzes. If you're looking for an easy A to boost your GPA take her!

You definitely need to pay attention to get an A but other than that, the class is really easy. We have one group project that we work on through out the semester, a final that you can bring a 5 page cheat sheet too, quizzes, and homework. The quizzes were definitely harder than expected and was sort of hard to finish in an hour.

Dr. Lenz is a good professor, and I highly recommend her to anyone looking to get an easy A for a core curriculum class. There is minimal work and all assignments and quizzes were open note except the final, which had a 5-page cheat sheet. She has daily attendance quizzes but also often cancels lectures in advance because she's 'ahead of schedule'.

Your experience in the Geology lab class may be based more on the TA you choose. However, Dr. Lenz's structure for the class was great. There were: simple practice quizzes due before the labs, lab assignments, and a group project at the end. The lowest two lab assignments and quizzes were dropped and the lab assignments were graded fairly. Easy A.

Final Exam worth 10% of my grade. Easy to get a 97-98 average before the final. 

Final was 6 essays that we got to prepare for to some extent.

Love her and how she taught the class, would STRONGLY recommend this class to knock out the cultural discourse credit!

We are graded by a few quizzes, assignments, and attendance in the course! We can bring a homemade study guide to the final exam and professor Lenz is willing to answer all questions and gives extra credit for talking in class. She's very sweet and the quizzes are typically a few free response questions.
EZ class. You have to want to pay attention to learn, but if you want a free A with minimal effort (and dont care about learning) this is your class. Dr Lenz is very sweet and knowledgable
Dr. Lenz is a great professor. If you have the chance to take her, DO IT! Unless you don't like group projects. Around 70% of her GEOS 110 class was group work.

Dr.Lenz is absolutely amazing, I loved her course. She is probably the nicest professor I have had here at A&M. She wants to see everyone succeed, and if you do your part she will ensure your grade shows as such.

I LOVE Dr. Lenz. She is super easy going and understanding. She told us on the first day that we should make an A in the class. It is not hard at all. Quiz's can be difficult but they are online and she gives you an hour. Group project, attendance, activities are what you are graded on. The only exam is the final which is worth 10% of ur grade.

Most boring lectures I've ever had to muscle through. This was her first time teaching in person. she said this class would be an easy A and allows you a 5 page cheat sheet that doesn't help because the tests cover 300-500 slides and ask the most mundane things that don't matter. Gets distracted easily and skips the important stuff to tell stories.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the most caring and understanding professors at tamu. Very passionate about the subject, and does everything she can to help her students. Allowed 5 page note sheets for the exams, but still make sure to study a little bit because there is a lot of content on the exams. Group assignments each week, but they are very easy and do not take long

Professor Lenz is very nice really cares about her students. I am not a fan of science but I enjoy her class. There is no homework and the exams come straight from the slides she presents in class. She allows you to make a 5-page cheat sheet to use on exams. I highly recommend taking her if you can!

I've had Brandi Lenz for more than one class, and she's easily been one of my favorite professors throughout my entire college career so far. Her lectures are fun, engaging, and she happily answers any questions you may have. She's super nice, and the exams and activities are easy as long as you show up to the lectures. Would take again!

Amazing Professor!! The class is super easy, and she is really passionate about the topics!!  Group-based work throughout the semester and a group project at the end.  Open note quizzes and an easy final exam.  Put in a little effort, and you will do great!!  A really good class if you need credit.

All assignments are group based, quizzes are open note, one final project that was enjoyable and an easy final exam. Take this class to fulfill some core curriculum credits! Professor loves her job and genuinely cares about every single student, so just talk with her if you have any issues at all going on.

Professor Lenz is a great professor. The material is interesting, and you can tell she cares about what she is teaching. All of the assignments are group work and the only exam is the final. I would recommend anyone take her class.
She's super sweet and has interesting lectures, the class is super easy and actually interesting! Just do your work and you'll be fine.

She's very passionate abt wat she's teaching. Lecture are very easy to understand. Quizzes are open-notes & she gives plenty of time (to reduce testing anxiety). All the activities and projects are done as a GROUP. Final presentation is worth 25% of ur grade & final is worth 10% of ur grade. Attendance counts for 10% of ur grade. Super easy class.
She is very passionate about disasters and society and has really interesting and relevant lecture material. Class grading is fairly easy and there are participation points for attendance.

One of the best, if not the best, professor on campus! She is incredibly kind, caring, knowledgeable, and passionate. Even though the class was 200+ students, she truly cared about each of us and was beyond understanding when issues arouse. Everyone needs to take a class with Dr. Lenz while at TAMU; she's amazing!

Prof. Lenz is an amazing professor. Im taking her online over the summer for the lab portion of geol 101/102, and plan on taking her for the lecture portion in the fall. She is by far on of my favorite professors I've had at college. If you can, take her classes. You will love them.
Super easy class and a great professor. She's super organized and sends reminders on due dates multiple times throughout the week. Definitely worth taking
Loved her!! Super easy A- just got to stay on top of weekly assignments. Highly recommend!!!!

Brandi Lenz is one of the sweetest and kindest professors I've ever met. She has so much passion for her field and it shows in her lectures. Overall the class work is very easy, including the final project and final exam which are both easy and graded leniently. It's practically impossible to not get an A in the class. Please take her

This class is a lot more informative than I thought it would be, but the lectures make it a little hard to pay attention. Dr. Lenz is a really caring professor, but many students often end up working on other classes during lecture time. There isn't a lot of homework, but there are some quizzes and activities that may take up some time.
Lenz was a great professor. She constantly sent out reminders to keep us on track because this was an online course. As long as you complete the material, this class should be easy.

Professor Lenz is a solid prof. She is passionate about what she teaches and makes the class very possible to get an A in. Consists of group work, quizzes, and a final group project. Best group projects get exempted from the final.

Dr. Lenz was an amazing prof. She is really passionate about what she teaches and doesn't make the class unessecarily hard. I actually enjoyed learning from her and I'm not even a science major. Her class is online and you are free to go at your own pace. Just remember to do the work she provides and to take the quizzes and you should get an easy A

Took the online course for this class so all of her lectures were done through videos of her own PowerPoints and notes, which were for very in depth and delivered most of the knowledge you needed for discussions or quizzes to you on a silver platter. The rest of the class assessments had more application or critical thinking using that knowledge
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Just want everyone who takes this class to see this. The textbook is NOT MANDATORY, DONT BUY. Her lecture vids are exactly what is in the book, so save some money. Exams are actually free, literally questions from the quizzes. If I were you, I would just look up answers as I go, unless you are seriously interested in learning geology.

Amazing professor! Very caring and understanding of students - easy to reach outside of class. Tons of extra credit, one group project, and attendance mandatory for activity days. Very laid back class that is an easy A and is fun to learn about the topics. STRONGLY RECOMMEND!

Best class I have ever taken. As a freshman it was nice to have a class that I was guaranteed an A in. As long as you do the once a week to once every two week assignments and quizzes, you'll get a high A. Open to questions and understanding to personal problems. 10/10 would recommend. Attendance is only mandatory some days of the semester.

I can't recommend Prof Lenz enough. She's so caring and understanding to her students and is a fair grader. There is rarely any homework and attendance isn't mandatory except for activity days, which happens once every few weeks. The content is really interesting too (coming from someone who isn't science-savvy) and the final exam is open-note.

Amazing teacher, there is probably one day a week that classes will be mandatory for in class group assignments, on non-mandatory days she might give extra credit for being in class. Quizzes and final were open note, she grades pretty easy on projects as long as she can tell you tried.

She is one of the sweetest professors here!  Since this is an online class she grades less on exams and more on participation, but if you do all your work you are guaranteed an A! She also drops a week worth of work because she understands life happens. I think she explains the material well enough in her lectures to not buy the textbook.

She is a great professor. I have no words. She is very passionate of what she teaches which makes the lectures interesting.  Her grading is very easy since majority is participation. Her quizzes are straightforward and open notes. There was a final project but it was not too bad. This class was my favorite to attend. I enjoyed listening to her.

By far the easiest class I've ever taken and one of the nicest and wholesome professors too. Take this class for a CD credit it's an easy A as long you participate, show up to class, and do the work. Professor Brandi is generous with extra credit, and partial credit on FRQ quiz questions. If you need a CD credit and an A, take this professor!

Brandi Lenz is clearly passionate about the field she is in, which makes her lectures informative, interesting, and entertaining, even in topics that I would otherwise have no interest in at all. All assessments are open-note and she grades very leniently. You will thank yourself for taking her class for the Cultural Discourse credit

I took GEOS 110 and really liked it. The class was easy, and the lectures were informative. Professor Lenz cares about her students, and is passionate about the topics. Almost all assignments were group work, and each group gives a final presentation.

She is incredibly passionate about her subject. Attendance is only mandatory on discussion/group days, but I highly recommend attending the lectures as well. They are very engaging, and she tends to give extra credit and quiz answers. This is one of my favorite classes this semester and is perfect for an easy science credit.
